models.name: Qwen3.8-27B (TeksEdge DFlash2 + lookup, RTX 3090)
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B with DFlash2 speculative decoding + context lookup on a single RTX 3090

engines.hardware: single RTX 3090 24GB at about 250W; optimized vLLM with DFlash2, 16-token verification blocks, ~15/16 tokens accepted
engines.quant: context-lookup workload reproducing a ~25K-token document already in the prompt (not free-running chat); DFlash2 alone ~260 tok/s on the same task, ordinary chat ~133 tok/s, initial setup 82 tok/s
engines.engine_min_version: optimized vLLM with DFlash2 + context lookup, 16-token verification blocks

models.why: The most-engaged figure in this leg: a single 24GB 3090 at ~250W went from 82 to 381 tok/s by combining DFlash2 with context lookup and 16-token verification — 15 of 16 tokens accepted per step — though only on workloads that reuse text already in the prompt.
